analysis.title: Virgin Galactic Holdings (SPCE): 3Q26 First Take: First commercial spaceflight delayed
key_insights: SPCE reported 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $(47)mn, in line with FactSet consensus of $(48.7)mn and better than GS estimate of $(53.5)mn.
First commercial spaceflight is now expected in early 2Q27, versus February 2027 previously.
A second spaceship is expected to begin commercial spaceflight in late 2Q/early 3Q 2027.
A new launch hangar and fueling infrastructure is planned to open in 2H 2028 and is expected to raise spaceflight capacity by 20% to 150 spaceflights per year.
First glide flight with Apeiron is expected in January 2027.
3Q26 revenue was $0.4mn. Free cash flow was $(99)mn, versus $(91)mn last quarter and $(108)mn a year ago.
GS rates SPCE Neutral with a 12-month price target of $3.05 (1.8x CY2027E EBITDA) against a $2.67 price, 14.2% upside.

market_movers.rationale: Price target is based on 1.8x CY2027E EBITDA. The first commercial flight slipped to early 2Q27 from February 2027.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA $(46.7)mn reported vs FactSet consensus $(48.7)mn and GS estimate $(53.5)mn, a 12.6% variance to GS.
3Q26 revenue $0.4mn reported, 6.7% above GS estimate, +17.0% y/y.
3Q26 diluted EPS $(0.39) reported vs GS estimate $(0.50). Diluted shares were 151.6mn vs GS 127.8mn.
3Q26 FCF $(99)mn reported vs $(91)mn in 2Q26 and $(108)mn in 3Q25. 4Q26 FCF guidance reiterated at $(90)-(80)mn.
GS estimates: 4Q26E EPS $(0.48), 1Q27E EPS $(0.33), FY26E revenue $5.8mn, FY27E revenue $257.0mn, FY27E EBITDA $(84.1)mn, FY28E EBITDA $26.4mn.
risk_factors: Timelines for commercial spaceflight, which have already slipped.
Ramp-up of production of additional spacecraft.
